## Microsoft Planetary Computer & ECMWF & STAC

[Python - Accessing ECMWF Open Data – Real Time](https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/dataset/ecmwf-forecast#Example-Notebook)

[R - Reading from the STAC API with R](https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/docs/quickstarts/reading-stac-r/)

[Datasets -ECMWF Open Data (real-time)](https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/dataset/ecmwf-forecast)

ECMWF - making some headway below in exploring ECMWF real time Open Data w/ Microsoft planetary data - using above links as guidance.

```{r}
library(rstac)
library(magrittr)
library(terra)

s_obj <- stac("https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/api/stac/v1/")
rstac::items_properties(items_ob)

s_obj
items_ob <- rstac::stac_search(
  q=s_obj,
  collections = "ecmwf-forecast"
  ) %>% 
  rstac::get_request() %>% 
  items_sign(sign_fn = sign_planetary_computer())

items_ob$features 
oper_forecast_items <- items_ob %>% 
  items_filter(
  properties$`ecmwf:type`=="fc",
  properties$`ecmwf:stream`=="oper"
  )
oper_forecast_items


```
